arxiv-1909-06946.title: A Stochastic Proximal Point Algorithm for Saddle-Point Problems
arxiv-1909-06946.creator: Luo Luo, Cheng Chen, Yujun Li, Guangzeng Xie and Zhihua Zhang Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Peking University
arxiv-1909-06946.description: Abstract We consider saddle point problems which objective functions are the average of n n strongly convex-concave individual components. Recently, researchers exploit variance reduction methods to solve such problems and achieve linear-convergence guarantees. However, these methods have a slow convergence when the condition number of the problem is very large.

arxiv-2209-04528.description: Abstract Modern neural network architectures have shown remarkable success in several large-scale classification and prediction tasks. arxiv-2408-11262.title: Quantum property preservation
arxiv-2408-11262.creator: Kumar Saurav, Daniel A. Lidar
arxiv-2408-11262.description: Abstract Quantum property preservation (QPP) is the problem of maintaining a target property of a quantum system for as long as possible. This problem arises naturally in the context of open quantum systems subject to decoherence. Here, we develop a general theory to formalize and analyze QPP.

arxiv-2501-06208.title: Enhancing AI Safety Through the Fusion of Low Rank Adapters
arxiv-2501-06208.creator: Satya Swaroop Gudipudi, Sreeram Vipparla, Harpreet Singh, Shashwat Goel, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru
arxiv-2501-06208.description: Abstract Instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) is a powerful method for improving task-specific performance, but it can inadvertently lead to a phenomenon where models generate harmful responses when faced with malicious prompts. In this paper, we explore Low-Rank Adapter Fusion (LoRA) as a means to mitigate these risks while preserving the model’s ability to handle diverse instructions effectively.

pmc-10527220.creator: Youjia Tian, Jiang Zhou, Xinxin Chai, Zejun Ping, Yurong Zhao, Xin Xu, Chi Luo, Jinghao Sheng, David Wong
pmc-10527220.description: Simple SummaryMelanoma is the deadliest form of skin cancer, with the BRAF(V600E) mutation being the most prevalent driver mutation. Despite targeted therapies against BRAF(V600E) mutation and immune checkpoint-blocking antibodies providing treatment options for patients, the heterogeneous nature of melanoma significantly limits treatment efficacy. Understanding diverse regulatory mechanisms in melanoma will shed light on improving the current treatment modalities.

pmc-12412948.creator: Hani Alahmadi, Muhammad Afzal, Naif Alkuhayli
pmc-12412948.description: This study explores the acoustic behavior of flexible cylindrical shells incorporating membrane discs at structural interfaces, focusing on their influence on wave propagation characteristics. The dynamics of the embedded membrane discs are modeled at the junctions between different shell segments, and the resulting boundary value problem is addressed using a combination of the Mode-Matching (MM) and Galerkin methods.

pmc-12461407.description: The rise of antibiotic resistance has necessitated the exploration of unconventional sources of novel antimicrobial agents. pmc-12992712.title: Scalable and stretchable 1D multifunctional fibers for multimodal sensing and stimulation
pmc-12992712.creator: Junyi Yin, Jinjin Zhu, Shaolei Wang, Jiangnan Yuan, Chenyang Li, Samuel Margolis, Hong Bao, Yanan Wang, Wei Zhao, Enbo Zhu, Longlong Mu, Shuai He, Kaidong Wang, Jie Zhao, YongAn Huang, Yunlei Zhou
pmc-12992712.description: One-dimensional (1D) multifunctional fibers have garnered significant attention due to their advantageous geometry properties, which allows conformal interfacing with soft biological tissues and efficient charge transport. Here, we developed a solution-deposition strategy for the scalable and cost-effective fabrication of stretchable liquid metal fibers integrated with electrochemically stable, tissue-interfacing electrodes, thereby enabling the realization of stretchable multifunctional fibers.

pmc-13356852.title: Review of Peptic Ulcer Disease: Insights from Pathophysiology, Mechanisms, Pharmacotherapy, Phytotherapy, and Case Reports
pmc-13356852.creator: Reza Pertiwi, Gofarana Wilar, Sri Adi Sumiwi, Jutti Levita
pmc-13356852.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Peptic ulcer disease (PUD) remains a significant global health concern associated with substantial morbidity. The primary etiologies include Helicobacter pylori infection and the use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), both of which impair gastric mucosal defense mechanisms. This review aims to provide an updated overview of the pathogenesis, clinical manifestations, diagnostic approaches, and current management strategies of PUD, including emerging therapeutic developments. Advances in diagnostic modalities, such as endoscopy and imaging, have improved early detection and clinical outcomes.

pmc-13375679.title: On the boundary Carrollian conformal algebra
pmc-13375679.creator: Lucas Buzaglo, Xiao He, Tuan Anh Pham, Haijun Tan, Girish S. Vishwa, Kaiming Zhao
pmc-13375679.description: We initiate the mathematical study of the boundary Carrollian conformal algebra (BCCA), an infinite-dimensional Lie algebra recently discovered in the context of Carrollian physics. The BCCA is an intriguing object from both physical and mathematical perspectives, since it is a filtered but not graded Lie algebra.

pmc-13635526.title: Novel ternary covalent complexes (OsrhLF-EGCG-Mal) based on plant-derived recombinant lactoferrin (OsrhLF) by polyphenol-carbohydrate dual-modification strategy
pmc-13635526.creator: Xueya Li, Xiaoyan Guan, Yeting Wu, Wanrong Wu, Yingying Li, Rui Liu, Zixian Xia, Yifeng Ding, Yanchun Shao, Youyou Lu
pmc-13635526.description: Bovine lactoferrin was widely used in food industry but suffered from resource dependence, environmental sensitivity and digestive inactivation susceptibility. As a promising alternative, the characteristics of plant-derived recombinant lactoferrin (OsrhLF) remained unclear. Herein, novel OsrhLF-EGCG-Mal ternary covalent complexes were innovatively constructed via dual-modification strategy with epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) and maltodextrin (Mal).
